title: Learning to Discover Iterative Spectral Algorithms
summary: We introduce AutoSpec, a neural network framework for discovering iterative spectral algorithms for large-scale numerical linear algebra and numerical optimization. Our self-supervised models adapt to input operators using coarse spectral information (e.g., eigenvalue estimates and residual norms), and predict recurrence coefficients for computing or applying a matrix polynomial tailored to a downstream task.
